name: 15"/42 AP 6crh
_formFactorComment: Multiplier on the shared drag curve in data/config/ballistics.json. Shells differ in how sharply pointed they are and how good their ballistic caps were, and that is a per-shell property, not a per-gun one. solved so the model reproduces the published maximum range of 32000 m at 30.0 degrees.
_fuzeComment: Time from the fuze triggering to detonation. This is what makes a shell burst deep inside a ship instead of at the plate, and what lets it pass clean through a thin-skinned destroyer without going off at all.
_capTypeComment: apc = armour-piercing cap. A cap improves penetration of face-hardened plate and can be stripped by a thin plate encountered first.
sources: NavWeaps.com naval gun and ammunition data
notes: Vanguard's mountings elevated to 30 degrees; sources differ on the exact deep-load range.
